params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad account.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

params.name: parameters
params.description: Contains the parameters for report identification.

items.docs: List aggregated numbers of issues for a catalog owned by the "operation user_account". - By default, the "operation user_account" is the token user_account. Optional: Business Access: Specify an ad_account_id (obtained via List ad accounts) to use the owner of that ad_account as the "operation user_account".
